title: Slurry.
officialText:
The proportions and installation of slurry mixtures to protect the sides of excavations shall be subject to
special inspection. Slurry mix proportions and installation procedures shall be provided by a registered design professional, and
the special inspection agency shall verify compliance with the approved procedures.
